hooks.command: if ! output=$(npm run build 2>&1); then echo "$output" | tail -20 | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: ("Build errors:\n" + .)}}'; fi

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then if ! output=$(npx eslint "$f" 2>&1); then echo "$output" | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: ("Lint errors:\n" + .)}}'; fi; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
